items.fullSentence: Je prends le petit-déjeuner à sept heures du matin.
items.sentenceTrans: I have breakfast at seven in the morning.

whyWrong.le déjeuner: That's lunch — seven in the morning is breakfast.
whyWrong.le goûter: That's the afternoon snack, not the morning meal.
whyWrong.le dîner: That's dinner — seven in the morning is breakfast.

items.fullSentence: À midi, on prend le déjeuner.

whyWrong.le petit-déjeuner: That's breakfast, eaten in the morning, not at noon.
whyWrong.le goûter: That's the afternoon snack, later than noon.
whyWrong.le dîner: That's dinner, eaten in the evening, not at noon.

items.sentenceBefore: Vers seize heures, les enfants prennent
items.fullSentence: Vers seize heures, les enfants prennent le goûter.
items.sentenceTrans: Around four in the afternoon, children have their snack.

whyWrong.le petit-déjeuner: That's the morning meal, not mid-afternoon.
whyWrong.le déjeuner: That's the midday meal, earlier than four o'clock.
whyWrong.le dîner: That's the evening meal, later than four o'clock.

items.fullSentence: Le soir, la famille prend le dîner ensemble.
items.sentenceTrans: In the evening, the family has dinner together.

whyWrong.le petit-déjeuner: That's the morning meal, not the evening.
whyWrong.le déjeuner: That's the midday meal, not the evening.
whyWrong.le goûter: That's the afternoon snack, not the evening meal.

items.fullSentence: Au petit-déjeuner, je bois souvent du café.
items.sentenceTrans: At breakfast, I often drink coffee.

whyWrong.de la soupe: Soup isn't a typical breakfast drink in France.
whyWrong.des frites: Fries aren't a drink at all, and not a breakfast food.

items.sentenceBefore: Pour le déjeuner, on mange souvent
items.fullSentence: Pour le déjeuner, on mange souvent du poulet avec des légumes.
items.sentenceTrans: For lunch, one often eats chicken with vegetables.

whyWrong.un croissant: That's a breakfast food, not a lunch main course.
whyWrong.du café: That's a drink, not something eaten with vegetables.
whyWrong.de la farine: Flour is a raw baking ingredient, not a lunch dish.

items.sentenceBefore: Pour le goûter, elle mange souvent
items.fullSentence: Pour le goûter, elle mange souvent une pomme.
items.sentenceTrans: For her afternoon snack, she often eats an apple.

whyWrong.du poisson: Fish is a meal food, not a typical afternoon snack.
whyWrong.de la viande: Meat is a meal food, not a typical afternoon snack.
whyWrong.des oignons: Onions are a cooking ingredient, not a snack.
